title: Maximum possible change
hints: Apply MVT to the full interval.
The secant slope has magnitude at most 7.
Multiply by the interval length of 4.
solution: MVT gives $|f(6)-f(2)|=4|f^\prime(c)|\le28$. A linear function with slope 7 attains the bound.
statement:
If $|f^\prime(x)|\le7$ on $(2,6)$ and $f$ is continuous on $[2,6]$, find the sharp upper bound for $|f(6)-f(2)|$.

[__________]{answer}
